infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sunfold uses your location to calculate the sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour times for exactly where you are. Times are computed on your device; your coordinates go to Apple's geocoder only to name your location.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Sunfold uses your location to calculate the sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour times for exactly where you are. Times are computed on your device; your coordinates go to Apple's geocoder only to name your location.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Sunfold does not use motion or fitness data. The location component it is built on references Apple's motion API, so iOS requires an explanation here even though Sunfold never asks for it.
